page: Google Cloud Platform z3-highmem-176-standardlssd is a memory-optimized server powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor with x86_64 architecture. It features 88 physical cores and 176 vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 1408 GB of RAM, providing a ratio of 8 GB of memory per vCPU. Storage is bundled directly, consisting of 12 local NVMe SSDs that deliver a total capacity of 38652 GB. No GPU accelerators are present on this instance.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier multi-core capabilities, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, PassMark CPU score, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression all placing in the top 10% of tested systems. The server also demonstrates top-tier memory bandwidth, reaching 11917.19 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 445.54 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Single-core performance, including stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores, falls within the average range. The hardware supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions, which contribute to strong performance in LLM prompt processing and cryptography tests.

Given its high resource density, including massive local NVMe storage and a large memory footprint, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring high-throughput data processing without the overhead of external storage networks. It is highly suitable for large-scale database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, and multi-threaded data processing pipelines. The combination of high memory capacity and local SSD storage also supports heavy compilation tasks and localized LLM inference workloads.
